h1: Video production, animation and AI video for Abu Dhabi organisations
intro: We make video for Abu Dhabi organisations that need to explain complex work clearly and look established doing it: brand films, animated explainers, short-form reels, motion graphics, AI video and live broadcast. Everything is produced in Arabic and English, planned with your marketing goals, and delivered by the same team that runs your ads and website.

sections.h: Work that is hard to film
p: Many organisations in the capital do work that is hard to film. An engineering contractor's best project is out at sea or behind a security fence. An investment firm's product is a process, not a thing. A clinic cannot film patients. A government supplier needs a capability film in two languages that a procurement committee will watch in silence.

That is where animation, motion graphics and carefully used AI video earn their place. They show what a camera cannot reach, explain a process in ninety seconds, and can be updated when the story changes without reshooting everything.

p: Energy and industrial service firms use animated explainers and 3D sequences to show equipment, processes and safety procedures they cannot film. Advisory and investment firms on Al Maryah Island want short, calm brand films and interview pieces with senior people, often subtitled for LinkedIn.

Hospitals and clinics need patient education videos and doctor introductions in Arabic and English, made with care around consent and privacy. Universities and schools want campus films and course explainers for prospective students abroad. Tourism, culture and hospitality businesses tied to Saadiyat Island, Yas Island and Al Ain look for reels and destination films that work for people planning a visit from overseas.

sections.h: Plan a year of video, not one film
p: A single brand film rarely changes much on its own. What works is a core piece plus a steady flow of shorter content: project updates, team introductions, client stories where permission allows, and explainers that answer the questions your sales team hears every week.

We plan the video production Abu Dhabi clients need a quarter at a time, batching shoots and animation so each production day produces several assets. The same footage then feeds your website, LinkedIn, paid campaigns and tender submissions, which keeps the cost per finished video down and the message consistent across every channel.

We script in both languages from the start rather than subtitling at the end. Arabic voiceover, on-screen text in right-to-left layout and subtitle timing all get native-speaker review. We also plan content around the calendar and local norms: what is appropriate to show, how to dress talent, and how tone shifts during Ramadan.
For government-facing and semi-government work, we follow your brand and approval process closely, and build extra review rounds into the schedule so sign-off does not squeeze the edit.

AI video can produce presenter-led explainers in several languages, or dozens of ad variations, far faster than a shoot. It is not right for everything. We use it where it helps, label it clearly, never imitate a real person without permission, and have a person review every frame before it goes out. For organisations near the capital's AI ecosystem, where audiences notice poor AI quickly, that review step matters more than speed.

sections.h: How production runs: Talk, Plan, Build, Grow
p: Talk: who the video is for, where it will be seen and what it should make people do. Plan: script, storyboard or animatic, shot list or style frames, and a schedule with review dates in writing. Build: production, animation, edit, sound, Arabic and English versions. Grow: cut-downs for each platform, testing in paid campaigns, and new versions based on what audiences watch.

We have run and broadcast more than 20 large-scale live events. The lesson is simple: the date does not move. That discipline goes into every production schedule, whether the deadline is a live stream, a conference opening or a campaign launch.

Animation, motion graphics, editing and AI video are produced remotely. Rough cuts arrive as review links you can comment on frame by frame, so feedback from several stakeholders lands in one place, and review calls are booked at times that suit your team. For live filming or a broadcast, we come to Abu Dhabi when the project needs it and plan the crew around the shoot. Before you approve any shoot, we tell you how it will be staffed and who is responsible on the day. Each version is checked against the brief before it is sent to you.

faqs.q: What kind of video production in Abu Dhabi do you handle?
faqs.a: The video production Abu Dhabi clients commission from us covers brand and capability films, short-form reels, animated explainers, motion graphics, AI video and live broadcast. Most projects mix formats: one core film, then cut-downs for LinkedIn, Instagram and paid campaigns, all in Arabic and English.

faqs.q: Do you film on location in Abu Dhabi?
faqs.a: Yes, when the project needs it. We plan the shoot, the crew and the required permissions with you in advance and travel for it. Much of our work is animation, motion graphics and editing, so many projects need no shoot at all.

faqs.q: Can you produce videos in Arabic?
faqs.a: Yes. We write scripts in both languages, record Arabic voiceover, build right-to-left on-screen text and have native speakers review everything. We plan Arabic and English versions together, so neither feels like an afterthought.

faqs.q: When should we use animation instead of filming?
faqs.a: Animation suits subjects you cannot film easily: assets at sea, secure sites, financial processes, medical procedures or products not yet built. It is also easier to update later. Filming suits people, places and real emotion. Many of our films combine both.

faqs.q: Is AI video suitable for a government-facing organisation?
faqs.a: Sometimes. AI presenters and generated scenes can work well for internal training and multilingual explainers. For public, government-facing content we label AI clearly, never imitate a real person without permission, and have a person review every frame. If live footage is the safer choice, we will say so.

faqs.q: Can you broadcast our conference or event live?
faqs.a: Yes. We have run and broadcast more than 20 large-scale live events. For video production, Abu Dhabi events get the same approach: a technical plan, rehearsals, backup connections and a crew briefed on the run of show. We agree the setup and staffing in writing before the day.

faqs.q: Can you run our video production every month?
faqs.a: Yes. For organisations producing video weekly, we run a managed editing team with a set monthly volume, brand templates and a clear review process. It is the same model we run for a US client, adapted for Arabic and English output.
